item.title: Assam Ranks Third in Northeast in Export Preparedness; Nagaland Tops the Region
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam has ranked third among Northeast states in export preparedness, according to the Export Preparedness Index (EPI) 2024 released by NITI Aayog, with Nagaland emerging as the top-performing state in the region. The index evaluates the export readiness of Indian states and Union Territories based on infrastructure, business ecosystem, policy support, and export performance.
